Makes the stops of a distance or slider constraint soft, like a spring, instead of hard. A frequency of 0 makes them hard again.
@param constraint A distance or slider constraint.
@param frequency How fast the spring swings, in Hz. About 1 is soft, 10 is stiff.
@param damping 0 swings for a long time, 1 does not swing.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
